acceptance_predicates.description: Plan creation enumerates the canonical supported workload catalog rather than a duplicated fixed list.
Every emitted plan validates through the existing ASB planner.

definition_of_done: Workload selection and plan materialization are reusable and tested.
New catalog entries are selectable without CLI source edits.
Credentials and runtime authority remain outside generated plans.

inputs.description: Canonical ASB workload and measurement catalogs.
